title: mri_probe_ima
description: Query Siemens IMA files to extract header information

ima_file.description: Path to the IMA file to be probed.
ima_file.title: IMA File

key_string.description: String from dictionary to query the IMA file.
key_string.title: Key String

offset_type_len.description: Offset, type, and string length for querying. Type can be short, int, long, float, double, or string.
offset_type_len.title: Offset Type and Length

attribute_name.description: Name of the file information attribute to query.
attribute_name.title: Attribute Name

dictionary.description: Dump the dictionary without the need of an IMA file.
dictionary.title: Dictionary Flag

ob_stem.description: Dump binary pixel data into bshort with stem prefix.
ob_stem.title: Output Binary Stem
